note:
WHY THESE FIVE READ AS ONE SET. Every frame is 4:3, deep-ground, one soft key, 85mm-class compression. That is not decoration: the category title sits ON the picture in white at the top, so each image has to hand the type a quiet dark top third, and five pictures lit five different ways would look like five unrelated stock buys stacked down one column.

THE TWO EXISTING ONES WERE CROPPED TO 4:3 BEFORE UPLOAD, not left square for the theme to crop. object-fit cover would have thrown the surplus away at every viewport with no say in what went; cutting them here chose what goes.

Products & Usage also had ~50px of ragged near-black film border baked in by NBP Flash, measured at 51/50/42/42 px on a 4096 square and trimmed at 70 to be safe. Left in, it would have shown as a dark bar down the left and right of the block.

ENGINE PER SLOT, AND WHY.
  shipping  NBP Pro     — the only candidate whose HELIX MARK is right. gpt-image spelled
                          'Skingenetix' correctly on both candidates but drew the mark as
                          bare dashes with no continuous strand. Checked at 100%: capital S,
                          bold italic lowercase, S-curve strand crossing the dashes with
                          scattered dots, and no other lettering anywhere on the box.
  returns   Seedream    — genuine unforced smile, screen angled away and invisible, and an
                          East Asian model, which with the West African model on Products &
                          Usage keeps the page from being one face repeated.
  skincare  NBP Flash   — closest crop of the nine, pores and vellus hair intact at 100%,
                          colourless droplet, plain glass with no graduation marks, and the
                          quietest top-left of the shortlist for the title to sit on.

Seedream returned the two pipette frames rotated on their side and both are unusable; FLUX.2 delivered one candidate per slot as it always does. Neither is a fault to fix, both are why the brief goes to every engine.
